summary: `sekrets adopt gh` step 1: every seat's gh runs through sekrets with an agent profile; people and st's daemon keep gh as before.

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

compatibility.detail: Opt-in: nothing changes until a person runs `sekrets adopt gh`. Then a seat's `gh` (ST_AGENT set) goes through the gateway with the agent profile and the gh-agent preset, which refuses `gh auth token` and other commands outside it; the person's shell and st's daemon run the real gh. Two grants of the same profile to one seat are no longer refused as ambiguous.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond a normal deploy.

manual.detail: To adopt: from a login session, `sekrets adopt gh` (log the agent profile in with `sekrets login gh --profile PERSON/agent-gh` if it reports no login). To undo: `sekrets unadopt gh`.

recovery.detail: `sekrets unadopt gh` removes the shim; profiles and grants can stay or be removed. `SEKRETS_DIRECT=1 gh` always runs the real gh.
